newsitem.title: USA: UStel Inc in tentative deal to buy Arcada.
newsitem.headline: UStel Inc in tentative deal to buy Arcada.

text.p: UStel Inc said on Wednesday that it had signed a letter of intent to acquire Arcada Communications, a privately held, telecommunications company based in Seattle.
The transaction is subject to the execution of a definitive agreement, due diligence and approval by the shareholders of both companies.
Arcada's revenues for calendar year 1996 were $12.6 million, UStel said.
UStel is a long distance, switch-based interexchange carrier whose calendar 1996 revenues were $22.0 million.
Terms of the deal were not immediately available.
